evidence_requirement: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); auth state is diagnosed READ-ONLY (presence, scope, whether a whoami still authenticates); no credential value is printed and no credential is modified

question_or_target: Which available backend serves each of the 16 declared source classes, what is each backend's current auth state, rate limit and failure signature, and what preflight must run before a fan-out so that a dead or quota-exhausted backend is detected BEFORE 50 agents launch against it?
retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after 2 failures on the same error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)
reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial refuter in a fresh context who defaults to REFUTED when evidence is insufficient (spec:11062)
tests_required: detector control: the preflight must report DOWN for a deliberately wrong endpoint and UP for a known-good one; a preflight that returns UP for both is not measuring reachability
